metadata.question: Was there a noticeable larger bloom (represented by a brighter blue color) in Hood Canal in late August 2022, compared to August 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Hood Canal, Washington (approximate coordinates: -122.9°W, 47.7°N) - Time periods: Late August 2021 vs Late August 2022 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for high-resolution RGB imagery to detect "brighter blue color" - Date ranges: August 20-31 for both years 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds since we're looking at water color - Use QA60 band for cloud masking in Sentinel-2 - Focus on water areas only 3. Logic: - Extract blue band values (B2 in Sentinel-2) from Hood Canal waters - Compare mean brightness between 2021 and 2022 - Valid Zero: If blue values are legitimately darker (lower values) = Answer B - Null/Error (C3): If calculations return None/NaN - Empty Collection (C1): If no images available - No Valid Pixels (C2): If all pixels masked out ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Hood Canal geometry (approximate area) const hoodCanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-122.95, 47.9], [-122.85, 47.9], [-122.85, 47.5], [-122.95, 47.5], [-122.95, 47.9]] ]); // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Load Sentinel-2 collections for both periods const col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(hoodCanal) .filterDate('2021-08-20', '2021-09-01') .map(maskS2clouds); const col2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(hoodCanal) .filterDate('2022-08-20', '2022-09-01') .map(maskS2clouds); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); const size2022 = col2022.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${size2021}`); console.log(`2022 Images: ${size2022}`); // Check if collections are empty if (size2021 === 0 || size2022 === 0) { console.log("Insufficient data for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Create median composites and extract blue band const img2021 = col2021.median().select('B2'); const img2022 = col2022.median().select('B2'); // 5. Calculate statistics with pixel count validation const stats2021 = img2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2022 = img2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2021 = stats2021.B2_mean; const count2021 = stats2021.B2_count; const mean2022 = stats2022.B2_mean; const count2022 = stats2022.B2_count; console.log(`2021 Blue Mean: ${mean2021}, Pixels: ${count2021}`); console.log(`2022 Blue Mean: ${mean2022}, Pixels: ${count2022}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2021 === 0 || count2022 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (mean2021 === null || mean2022 === null || isNaN(mean2021) || isNaN(mean2022)) { console.log("Calculation returned invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Compare blue brightness (higher values = brighter blue) const percentIncrease = ((mean2022 - mean2021) / mean2021) * 100; console.log(`Percent Change: ${percentIncrease.toFixed(2)}%`); // Consider >10% increase as "noticeable larger bloom" if (mean2022 > mean2021 && percentIncrease > 10) { console.log("2022 shows noticeably brighter blue (larger bloom)."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No noticeable larger bloom in 2022."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
